summary: Evidence through 2019-11-07 shows no breach or pressure on existing covenants; all clauses remain appropriate and no material drift is detected.

clauses.rationale: No evidence of leverage ratio stress or covenant breach; the scheduled minimum ratio remains suitable.
Annual reporting and compliance certificate requirements have not shown delays or inadequacy.
Quarterly reporting obligations continue to be met; no evidence justifies a change.
Monthly reporting and compliance certificate obligations remain appropriate based on available evidence.
Notice periods for defaults and material adverse effect have not been challenged; retain as is.
New indebtedness from acquisitions fits within existing baskets; no evidence of exceeded limits.

drift_reasons: Evidence shows revenue growth and some debt incurrences, but none indicate covenant breach, insufficient coverage, or need to tighten/loosen any term; the current package remains adequate.
